Container.Name: Playlister
Container.Overview: Self-hosted bot that watches public Apple Music playlists and posts to a Discord channel whenever a new song is added. Everything (the Discord webhook and the watched playlists) is configured from the built-in web UI—no environment variables are required.
Container.Description: Self-hosted bot that watches public Apple Music playlists and posts to a Discord channel whenever a new song is added. Configure the Discord webhook and add playlists from the built-in web UI.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the management web UI.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persists settings, the watch list, and playlist snapshots.

Config.Name: POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS
Config.Description: How often to poll Apple Music, in seconds.

Config.Name: DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Seeds the Discord webhook on first run only—you can set this in the web UI instead.

Config.Name: PLAYLISTS
Config.Description: Optional. Comma/newline separated playlist URLs used to seed the watch list on first run only—you can add these in the web UI instead.
